releases.title: Relay Tower, rebuilt
releases.summary: Relay Tower, rebuilt. Our first map gets the full treatment: craggy floating islands, real lattice masts, a new dusk sky and sea of clouds. Pick your map from the menu, and the library’s reading table is fixed.

releases.title: The Operator’s Study
releases.summary: A new game, and a new map. Shrink to mouse size in an old radio operator’s house: the study, the hallway and the library, with five ways between the bases, behind the bookcases, under the floorboards and through the ducts. Grapple, fling, snipe, capture.
